Lily found a shiny gray rock in her backyard. She showed it to her dad, who said it was zinc. He told her zinc keeps boats from rusting in the water. Lily put the zinc in her pocket and took it to school. She showed it to her teacher, who said it was very special. Lily kept the zinc on her desk all day.
Zip loves to zip his jacket up all by himself. He pulls the little tab and it goes up fast. He zips it every morning before going outside. The jacket keeps him warm when the wind blows. He feels proud when he zips it all the way to the top.
Lily got a new jacket with a shiny zipper. She pulled it up all by herself for the first time. It went up smoothly and made a happy click sound. She showed her dad how she could zip it. He smiled and gave her a high five. She wore it to school and felt very proud.
Leo looked up at the night sky and saw the stars. She pointed to a group of stars that looked like a lion. Her mom said that was her zodiac sign. Leo smiled and said she liked being a lion. She looked at the stars every night after that.
Tom dressed as a zombie for Halloween. He wore old gray clothes and green face paint. He walked slowly like a zombie in the dark. His friends laughed when they saw him. He made funny zombie sounds and they all giggled. At the end of the night, he washed off the green paint and smiled.
Tom went to the zoo with his dad. He saw a big lion in a cage. The lion roared very loud. Tom watched it walk back and forth. He liked the tall giraffe the most. It ate leaves from a high tree. Tom waved at it and smiled. He had a fun day at the zoo.
Lily loves learning about zoology. She looks at pictures of animals in her big book. She points to a lion and says it is a mammal. She sees a bird and learns it has feathers. She draws a fish with scales and fins. Zoology helps her understand all the animals she loves.
Zoroaster was a wise man who lived long ago. He taught people to be kind and tell the truth. He believed in one good light and one dark shadow. He told stories about fire being a symbol of goodness. People listened to him and shared his ideas. His words helped many people choose to do good things.
Lily found a big green zucchini in the garden. She picked it and carried it to the kitchen. She washed it with water and dried it with a towel. Then she cut it into small pieces for soup. The zucchini made the soup taste yummy. Lily ate every bite and smiled.
Zulu people live in a sunny land called South Africa. They wear bright clothes and sing happy songs. A little Zulu boy named Sipho danced with his family. He shook his arms and stomped his feet to the drum beat. The drum went boom-boom, and he smiled wide. He loved to dance with his people under the big sky.
